puzzle.title: 雨后换乘
puzzle.flavor_text: 每座站台混入了一件不属于另外三件同类事物的行李。先找出每站的异类及其标签，再根据换乘记录恢复唯一线路。
puzzle.content:
| 站台 | 行李 | 异类背面的标签 |
|---|---|---|
| K | copper, iron, silver, willow | O |
| Q | square, triangle, circle, Tuesday | P |
| M | violin, cello, harp, pepper | C |
| R | Paris, Lima, Cairo, helium | S |
| B | robin, eagle, finch, salmon | M |
| T | running, cycling, swimming, marble | S |
| H | apple, pear, peach, beet | A |

换乘记录：
- R 在 H 之后、T 之前。
- Q 紧跟 B。
- K 紧跟 M。
- H 紧跟 Q。
- T 是终点。
- B 紧跟 K。

observations.text: Title is '雨后换乘', which translates to 'Transfer after rain' or 'Rain transfer'.

Flavor text: '每座站台混入了一件不属于另外三件同类事物的行李。先找出每站的异类及其标签，再根据换乘记录恢复唯一线路。' Translation: 'Each platform has one piece of luggage that does not belong to the same category as the other three. First find the odd one out and its label at each station, then restore the unique route according to the transfer records.'
Table has columns: 站台 (Platform), 行李 (Luggage), 异类背面的标签 (Label on the back of the odd item).
Platform K items: copper, iron, silver, willow. Odd item label: O.
Platform Q items: square, triangle, circle, Tuesday. Odd item label: P.
Platform M items: violin, cello, harp, pepper. Odd item label: C.
Platform R items: Paris, Lima, Cairo, helium. Odd item label: S.
Platform B items: robin, eagle, finch, salmon. Odd item label: M.
Platform T items: running, cycling, swimming, marble. Odd item label: S.
Platform H items: apple, pear, peach, beet. Odd item label: A.
There are 7 platforms with labels K, Q, M, R, B, T, H.
Transfer records: 'R 在 H 之后、T 之前。' means R is after H and before T.
Transfer records: 'Q 紧跟 B。' means Q immediately follows B.
Transfer records: 'K 紧跟 M。' means K immediately follows M.
Transfer records: 'H 紧跟 Q。' means H immediately follows Q.
Transfer records: 'T 是终点。' means T is the terminal/end.
Transfer records: 'B 紧跟 K。' means B immediately follows K.
In platform K group (copper, iron, silver, willow), copper, iron, silver are metals, willow is a tree.
In platform Q group (square, triangle, circle, Tuesday), square, triangle, circle are shapes, Tuesday is a day of the week.
In platform M group (violin, cello, harp, pepper), violin, cello, harp are musical instruments, pepper is a spice/vegetable.
In platform R group (Paris, Lima, Cairo, helium), Paris, Lima, Cairo are capital cities, helium is a chemical element.
In platform B group (robin, eagle, finch, salmon), robin, eagle, finch are birds, salmon is a fish.
In platform T group (running, cycling, swimming, marble), running, cycling, swimming are sports/activities, marble is a stone/toy.
In platform H group (apple, pear, peach, beet), apple, pear, peach are fruits, beet is a vegetable.
The odd item labels are single letters: O, P, C, S, M, S, A for platforms K, Q, M, R, B, T, H respectively.
The labels on the odd items, in platform order K, Q, M, R, B, T, H, spell: O, P, C, S, M, S, A.

hypotheses.mechanism: Identify the odd item on each platform, use its given label, then order the platforms according to the transfer constraints and read the labels to get the final answer. The platform order from the constraints is M → K → B → Q → H → R → T, yielding labels C, O, M, P, A, S, S, which spells COMPASS.

The labels themselves are an anagram of COMPASS, but the puzzle requires using the transfer records to derive the correct order (M, K, B, Q, H, R, T). Reading labels in this order yields COMPASS, which is the intended answer. The anagram property is coincidental but confirms the letter set.

The answer might be derived from the odd items themselves (willow, Tuesday, pepper, helium, salmon, marble, beet) rather than just the labels. Their initial letters (W, T, P, H, S, M, B) could be arranged or interpreted differently after transfer ordering, possibly forming another word or clue.
